additionalRules: An Erebor & Dale Army must include Girion and at least one Unique Erebor Hero.
Erebor Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of an Erebor Hero.
Dale Warrior models can only be included in the Warband of a Dale Hero.

Ignore the usual rules for Bow Limit and Throwing Weapon Limit in this Army List. Instead, a maximum of 50% of your Dale Warrior models can have a bow, and a maximum of 50% of your Erebor Warrior models can have throwing weapons.

specialRules.name: Alliance of Men and Dwarves
specialRules.text: Friendly Dale models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes if there is a friendly Erebor model Engaged in the same Combat. Friendly Erebor models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes if there is a friendly Dale model Engaged in the same Combat.

specialRules.name: Lords of the Kingdoms
specialRules.text: Friendly Dale models treat Girion as a banner. Friendly Erebor models treat Thror as a banner.

specialRules.name: Great Prosperity
specialRules.text: Whenever a friendly Hero model spends a Might Point, roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Might Point was free and does not reduce the Hero model's store of Might.

specialRules.name: Windlance Trained
specialRules.text: If Girion is upgraded to take a Windlance, then he counts as the only crew for the Siege Engine. Girion may Move further than 6" away from the Windlance at any point and may rotate it without suffering the -1 penalty to his rolls To Hit. Additionally, when making a shooting attack with the Windlance that targets a Monster model, Girion gains a bonus of +1 to any rolls on the Scatter Table.

specialRules.name: Lord of Dale
specialRules.text: Girion's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6". Additionally, friendly Dale models within 3" of Girion may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Arkenstone
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. The bearer of the Arkenstone passes Fate Rolls on a 3+. Additionally, when making a Fate Roll, if the result is a 4 or better, then the Fate Point is free and is not spent.

specialRules.name: The Ring of Durin
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of wargear. Once per game during the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, the bearer of the Ring of Durin can re-roll their side's Priority Roll.

specialRules.name: Guardians of the King
specialRules.text: Any Grim Hammer Warriors upgraded to Guardians of the King in Thror's warband will have a Strength value of 4.

specialRules.name: Durin's Heir
specialRules.text: Thrain's Stand Fast has a range of 12". Additionally, friendly Dwarf Hero models may benefit from Thrain's Stand Fast.

specialRules.name: The Ring of Durin
specialRules.text: Once per game during the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, the bearer of the Ring of Durin can re-roll their side's Priority Roll. If your army does not include Thror, Thrain carries the Ring of Durin.

specialRules.name: Longbeard
specialRules.text: During the Priority Phase, after the roll for Priority has taken place, Balin can spend a Will Point to allow his controlling player to re-roll their roll for Priority.

specialRules.name: Grasper & Keeper
specialRules.text: These are Unique hand weapons. Additionally, a model gains a bonus of +1 to its Attacks characteristic when using Grasper & Keeper, and any To Wound Rolls of a natural 6 that are not prevented will deal 2 Wounds rather than 1.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Fury
specialRules.text: At the start of a Combat involving Dwalin, roll a D6. On a 5+, Dwalin may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls during that Combat. On a 2-4, nothing happens. On a 1, Dwalin reduces his Fight Value by D3 before the Duel Roll takes place.

specialRules.name: The Oakenshield
specialRules.text: This is a Unique shield. Additionally, if Thorin elects to shield with the Oakenshield and wins the Combat, then he may inflict a single Strength 4 hit on one enemy model involved in the Combat.

specialRules.name: To Arms!
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of his Activation, Thorin can declare he is using this special rule. If he does, then until the end of the turn all friendly Erebor models within 3" of Thorin increase their Strength by 1.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Wall of Blades
specialRules.text: This model gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes with their spear against a model that Charged them this turn.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Erebor & Dale army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text from the matching Dwarven Holds and Kingdoms of Men (Dale) faction pages on the same site.
